title: Interior Design
summary: Complete interiors designed around the way you live, from the first sketch to the final styled reveal. We bring colour, light, texture and furniture together into one considered, timeless whole.

title: Space Planning
summary: Beautiful rooms start with a layout that works. We plan how every space flows and functions, so it feels open, practical and effortless to live in, whatever its size.

title: Furniture & Décor Sourcing
summary: The right pieces make a room. We source furniture, lighting, art and accessories from trusted suppliers and craftspeople, then manage ordering and delivery for you.

title: Renovation & Styling
summary: From statement feature walls and custom joinery to full room makeovers, we manage the transformation and style the finished space so it is ready to enjoy.
included: Project management from start to finish
